title: Integer multiplicity current of an integer-weighted bi-Lipschitz image piece (supplied step 5(b)–(c))
statement: Assume (MR) and (IMC). (MR) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open, an IMRep R in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and every open W, M_W(T) = T.massOn W = R.measure W. (IMC) is the exact frozen type of the accepted Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, the conjunction of: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces: for U ⊆ ℝ^P open and Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M and every subspace Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q; (b) restriction: for U open, an IMRep R in U and a Borel set E there are a current A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and an IMRep R' with R'.Represents A, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E, R'.mult = R.mult, R'.orient = R.orient; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity if A, B are (U open); (d) for every IMRep R, for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ R.carrier and every n-covector α, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, κ > 0, H : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P L-Lipschitz, A ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel with κ|a − a'| ≤ |H(a) − H(a')| for a, a' ∈ A, H differentiable with injective derivative at every point of A, and g : ℝⁿ → ℤ measurable with g(a) ≠ 0 for a ∈ A and g Lebesgue integrable on A. Then there is an integer multiplicity Φ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with Φ(ω) = ∫_A g(u)·ω(H(u))(DH(u)e_0, …, DH(u)e_{n−1}) du for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), and M(Φ) ≤ Lⁿ·∫⁻_A |g| dλ.
